newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cantabrico to invest 12.5 bln ptas in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Cantabrico to invest 12.5 bln ptas in 1997.

text.p: Spanish electricity firm Hidroelectrica del Cantabrico (Cantabrico) will invest 12.5 billion pesetas in 1997, up 39 percent from 1996, the firm said on Tuesday.
Of this amount, four billion pesetas will go towards improving service quality and extending the current network.
Modernising fossil-fueled plants will take up 2.45 billion pesetas, and 250 million pesetas will be invested in updating hydroelectric plants.
Cantabrico said it will also improve its fibre-optic communications system, as well as preparing the ground for the future split between generation and distribution activities.
More than two billion pesetas will be spent on extending the Asturias regional gas network. The Gas de Asturias subsidary is expected to add 10,000 customers this year, the firm said.
